1. Composition and main uses of the precision stranding machine

This precision stranding machine can be used for the bunched stranding of small cross-section wires. It is composed of a single-twist machine, a separating wire plate, a twisting cage and an electric motor.

2. Preparations before production with the precision stranding machine

1. Place the special tools and measuring instruments on the workbench, and check that the measuring instruments are zeroed.

2. Check that the precision stranding machine is normal, especially the stop/start device and the protective-cover power-cut safety switch. If any abnormality is found, report it to the maintenance personnel for repair immediately.

3. Prepare the semi-finished products according to the production plan, check that they have passed inspection and meet the process standards, mount the qualified semi-finished products onto the single-twist machine, fit the taper sleeve, and adjust the tension to the correct setting.

4. According to the quantity, lay diameter and lay direction specified in the process standard, mount the change gears, adjust the lay direction, select the combining die according to the process standard and install it. Prepare the take-up reel as required, check that it is intact, and mount the take-up reel on the take-up frame.

5. Pull a leader wire through the guide roller and the guide tube all the way to the traction wheel inside the cage, wrap it around the traction wheel 3 to 4 turns, and fix one end of the leader wire in the take-up reel.

3. Usage essentials of the precision stranding machine

1. Pass each single wire separately through the auto-stop device and the separating wire plate, pull them to the front of the combining die, twist the wire bundle into one strand, pass it through the combining die, pull out 0.5 to 1.0 m, and fix the combining die on the die seat.

2. Join the wire strand to the leader wire, close the protective cover, start the machine slowly, and when the joint reaches the take-up reel, wind two turns onto the take-up reel. Stop the machine, cut off the unqualified part of the joint, pull out the leader wire, and fix the qualified joint on the take-up reel.

3. Start bunched stranding for 20 to 30 m; check according to the requirements whether the wire diameter of the individual wires has been drawn down, whether the lay direction conforms to the process standard, whether the core wires are glossy and free of looseness, and only when confirmed correct may production continue.

4. While the precision stranding machine is running, observe frequently the running condition of the reel of the single-twist machine and the winding condition of the take-up reel. If any abnormality occurs, stop the machine immediately, find out the situation and handle it, and then restart.

5. After production is completed, fill in the product manufacturing card carefully, place the products in the pending-inspection area, and after the process inspector confirms they are qualified and stamps the card, place them in the qualified-product area pending final inspection.

4. Quality standards

All the bunched strands must not be welded as a whole bundle; individual wires may be welded, but no more than two joints are allowed in the same cross-section, the distance between two joints should be not less than 300 mm, and the joints must be firm and smooth. The bunched core wires must not be missing wires, broken, loose or overlapped; the individual wire tolerance, lay diameter and lay direction in the core should conform to the process standard.

The cage stranding machine is a very good application product, and it also has many unique advantages and properties. Now let us look at the advantages and the scope of application of the cage stranding machine.

It has good mechanical properties and electrical insulation performance, and its stability gives good water resistance and oil resistance. In addition, it is also easy to process and form. Compared with traditional rebar processing equipment, the cage-type rolling machine not only breaks the tedious point-by-point operation mode of the traditional bending machine, but also effectively realizes the automation of rebar bending and significantly improves the positioning accuracy of the rebar bending angle. Therefore, in modern infrastructure construction, the popularity of the rebar cage rolling machine is being promoted and the utilization rate of the equipment improved.

Scope of application of the cage stranding machine:

1. Bridge pile foundation sites: the CNC rebar cage rolling machine can bend 6-40 mm or 6-50 mm rebar into the various shapes required for bridge construction.

2. Rebar straightening and adjustment: the CNC rebar cage rolling machine straightens and adjusts plain carbon steel, deformed rebar and other geometric shapes required by the workers.

3. The CNC rebar cage rolling machine can perform vertical bending of rebar after casting or tying, such as for shear wall topping, building capping columns, bending the main bars at the head of a rebar cage, and aligning main bars after pile splitting.

2. Low labor intensity. Large-diameter rebar cages have obvious production advantages; 2 to 3 people can complete the whole operation of the machine.

4. Select the wrapping die core according to the process standard, install the wrapping die plate, and reset the length counter to zero.

Operating procedures

1. Pass the wire end through the guide roller and pull the length counter to the wrapping die core, then fix the wire end.

2. Start the machine; after the wires are arranged neatly, start the linked run while keeping the wires arranged neatly.

3. After the wire is wrapped to the required length, tie it firmly with a three-strand fiber rope, and then lower the wrapping plate and the wrapping core.

4. Wrap the packaging wire of the new coil with packaging film, and put the corresponding identification in place according to the specification and length.

Quality standards

1. The wire surface is smooth and glossy, with no scorched material, eccentric core or mechanical damage.

2. The products after coiling must be arranged neatly, without disorder.

3. The model, specification and length on the identification must be consistent with the products; mistakes are prohibited!

The wrapping machine manufacturer talks about the comparison between Cat5e and Cat6 twisted pair cables. In ordinary homes or office areas, the network cables we use are all twisted pair cables. Twisted pair cables can be divided into several types according to transmission speed, such as Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6a, Cat7, and so on. At present, the most widely used type on the market is Cat5e, while Cat6 twisted pair cable is the trend of future development. So what differences exist between Cat5e and Cat6 twisted pair cables?

The biggest difference between Cat5e and Cat6 network cables is that they are used for different network tiers: Cat5e twisted pair cable is applicable to 100 Mbps networks, while Cat6 twisted pair cable is applicable to Gigabit networks. From this it can be seen that Cat6 network cable transmits faster than Cat5e. Cat6 twisted pair cable can better satisfy people's data transmission requirements, which is also an inevitable trend of network development.

Twisted pair cables are divided into shielded and unshielded types. Shielding effectively prevents external electromagnetic interference, ensures the accuracy of information transmission, and prevents others from stealing sensitive information. Therefore, the difference between Cat5e and Cat6 twisted pair cables can also be compared in terms of shielding performance: the shielding performance of Cat5e shielded twisted pair cable is weaker than that of Cat6 shielded twisted pair cable.

Cat5e and Cat6 twisted pair cables also differ in physical identification: Cat5e twisted pair cable is marked "CAT5E", while Cat6 twisted pair cable is marked "CAT6", recognizable at a glance from the outer surface. In addition, they also differ in structure. Cat6 twisted pair cable adds an insulating cross skeleton, which places the four pairs of twisted wire into the four grooves of the cross skeleton respectively, and the cable diameter is also thicker.

In addition, in terms of price, Cat6 twisted pair cable is more expensive than Cat5e, which is also a factor in the relatively wide application of Cat5e twisted pair cable.

Cat5e twisted pair cable is currently a mainstream product in integrated cabling projects, and it has excellent compatibility and better supports smooth network operation. Although Cat6 twisted pair cable outperforms Cat5e in all aspects, Cat5e is still the mainstream at present. In the future, Cat6 twisted pair cable will gradually become more deeply rooted in integrated cabling, and gradually replace Cat5e twisted pair cable.

The above is the comparison between Cat5e and Cat6 twisted pair cables described by the wrapping machine.

The stranding machine is a cable machine used for stranding core wires such as power cords, earphone wires and electronic wires. Its main stranding principle is: when the copper wires pass through the stranding bow on the stranding machine, the stranding bow, through circular motion, makes each individual copper wire wind helically together; stranded copper wire is the field that uses the largest quantity of single copper wire. Copper wires of different specifications and counts are twisted together in a certain arrangement order and at a certain lay, becoming a conductor of larger diameter. This stranded conductor is much softer than a single copper wire of the same diameter, and the wires made from it also have better bending performance.

Definition of the lay of the stranding machine: each individual wire appears once at a fixed distance along the stranding direction; this fixed distance is the lay length of the strand, or pitch for short. Another definition of lay: it refers to the vertical distance that the stranded wire body advances after rotating 360 degrees about the stranding axis, in mm; in English it is called the pitch.

A bunched wire is formed by twisting multiple single wires. Generally, the single wires of a bunch are many and fine, which increases the flexibility of the wire and cable and also improves the reliability of circuit connection. To obtain better flexibility or high reliability, the conductors of some wires and cables adopt the twisted form.

To bunch or strand the single wires at a certain helix angle (or lay), the equipment must meet the following requirements: first, all the single wires should make a rotational motion around the central axis of the equipment; second, the stranded product should make a straight-line forward motion. By changing the coordination of these two motions, the size of the helix angle can be adjusted so that the stranded wire or bunched wire produced meets the structural requirements.

The stranding machine is mainly composed of the pay-off unit, the haul-off unit, the traverse and take-up unit, the drive and transmission system, and the control system. In addition, there are devices such as separating plates, combining dies (also called pressing dies), and length counters.

The stranding machine produces stranded wire of relatively large specification. When stranding, apart from the central single wire, the pay-off reels of the other single wires are all placed in the pay-off part (such as the stranding cage). Through its rotation, the single wires form a stranded layer around the central wire. According to the number of stranded layers and the number of single wires in each layer, stranding machines generally have several (or several sections of) separately rotating pay-off parts, so that stranded wire with a different lay direction in each layer can be made; hence it is especially suitable for producing concentric lay stranded wire. The bunched wire produced by a bunching machine is of smaller specification; it is formed by the rotation of the basket frame or the rotating body in the take-up part. Because the running actions of the bunching machine all take place in the take-up part, with the speed change mechanism installed inside the rotating basket frame where the space is limited, the bunching machine can only make twisted products of one lay direction and smaller specification. However, the number of single wires to be bunched can be flexibly configured as needed.

The extrusion machine equipment production operator is the person responsible for maintaining and servicing the machine and increasing the working service life of the extrusion machine. Every operator must understand that reducing the frequency of inspection and repair of the extrusion machine, reducing the frequency of part replacement, and increasing the working service life of the extrusion machine are the principal measures for lowering the cost of plastic products and improving economic and social benefits. The equipment being able to work in its best condition for a long time, and the stability of plastic quality and total output, are the principal criteria for ensuring that manufacturing enterprises enjoy higher profits.

Operators who work carefully in accordance with the safety operating procedures and are dedicated and responsible give the equipment the best maintenance and care. Therefore, before new workers come on duty, they must first learn and memorize the safety operating procedures of the extrusion machine; only after passing the operating process assessment can they truly come on duty and operate independently.

To work independently and become a qualified extrusion production operator, the following matters require special attention:

(1) At shift handover, remind the next shift of the problems arising from this shift's production equipment and hand over the details clearly; keep proper handover records of the shift's total output, the product quality and the safety tools used in production.

(2) At shift takeover, after completing the handover procedures, first check the manufacturing quality of the product, inspect the quality of the raw materials used for production, and check the quantity of materials in the extrusion machine hopper. If any problem is found, report it to the person in charge immediately.

(3) Check whether the barrel and process control temperature of the extrusion machine is within the process temperature range stipulated in the production standard. It may be adjusted appropriately according to the product quality status and your own practical operating experience.

(4) Walk a full inspection lap around the production equipment, check the working condition of each transmission part while the equipment is running, see whether the rotation is stable and normal, listen for any abnormal noise at work, and check whether the heating position ambient temperature works normally.

(5) Look at the gauges to check the main motor working voltage and the ammeter needle on the operating control cabinet; at this time the ammeter needle should be within the normal rated voltage value range.

(6) Production proceeds normally. While the screw of the extrusion machine rotates steadily, the plastic products are extruded at a uniform, stable speed from the machine; from time to time, check the surface quality of the equipment, or take some products to check whether the various indicators of the equipment are qualified.

(7) In the event of a sudden power failure during work, first turn off the power switches of the main motor, electric heating and feeding system, and turn the knobs of the speed regulating switches to the zero position. When the power supply is restored, first heat and raise the temperature of the barrel; after the process temperature is reached, hold the temperature for a period of time. Manually turn the motor drive belt to test the frictional resistance of the screw rotation; if it is relatively easy to turn, run the motor at low speed and start working. If the ammeter needle exceeds the rated voltage value or the screw speed ratio is unstable, stop immediately, look for the cause (it may be that the material temperature in the barrel is low), investigate the root cause of the fault according to the rules and eliminate it before restarting.

(8) If the machine is shut down for a long time or production is stopped, and the material inside the barrel is a polyolefin-based raw material, it does not need to be removed. If the barrel contains acrylic resin or other materials, the material in the barrel must be removed; then disassemble the screw and remove the adhered material from the screw and the barrel; after the finished products in the screw and barrel are thoroughly cleaned, apply a layer of rust preventive, wrap the screw well, and hang it vertically in a dry, well-ventilated place.

The above is the safety note for equipment production operators described by the extrusion machine manufacturer; we hope this article can help you.

High-speed stranding machines have gone through half a century of evolution from hand-cranked, to automatic, to fully automatic. A fully automatic high-speed stranding machine must necessarily apply many kinds of automation technologies, mainly including control systems, transmission control, motion control, industrial touch screens and sensors. Driven by market demand, fully automatic high-speed stranding machines are now widely used, but the market has long since presented a flourishing scene of many varieties. So what are the adjustment methods for the spindle of a fully automatic high-speed stranding machine? The stranding machine manufacturer will introduce them below.

The stranding machine manufacturer

Many purchasers of fully automatic high-speed stranding machines simply use the equipment according to the setup and configuration established at the time of purchase, just as they would follow a car dealership's arrangement. Some customers, however, need to change the position or function of certain components of the fully automatic high-speed stranding machine to suit their own production process. When designing and manufacturing, a certain amount of space is generally reserved for convenient maintenance and the dismantling of components. Customers can use this space to make certain improvements, but all improvements must remain within the maximum values permitted by the equipment; making arbitrary, blind modifications to the equipment will damage it.

The spindle of a fully automatic high-speed stranding machine is the drive shaft that provides rotational force to turn the wire being stranded. Machines of different sizes have different spindle configurations. Spindle adjustment generally includes the following aspects: the shaft outlet position, coaxiality adjustment, and additional winding process features. The shaft outlet position usually needs adjustment when, during the winding stage, the clearance between the spindle and the machine table does not meet the production process requirements, since every production process requires a certain working space. When adjusting the shaft outlet position, pay attention to the size of the opening in the main frame and whether the adjustment will affect the basic operation of other components. Coaxiality adjustment is common: after the fully automatic high-speed stranding machine has been running for a period, the coaxiality between the winding reel and the mold pin may deviate, and it must be inspected and adjusted as soon as possible.

Adjustment of the wire traversing device is generally the adjustment of the traverse interval and the rotation diameter. The traverse interval adjustment is made when the starting winding point of the machine does not match the winding process. The method is generally to move the machine's homing sensor. Note that the position movement must not exceed the mechanical starting point of the equipment; leave as much clearance as possible, so as to ensure that the equipment cannot cause a mechanical collision when returning to its home position. Because different stranding machine manufacturers produce machines with different adjustment methods, customers should contact the stranding machine manufacturer in good time before making any adjustment, so as to master the key adjustment steps.

There are many kinds of magnet wire coils, using various winding wires and with diverse requirements. For some magnet coil products with special requirements, domestic manufacturers once gave up one after another. After these years of technological digestion and absorption, the process capability of fully automatic high-speed stranding machines has been developing steadily, and even the models with special requirements can now be handled much more easily. With the increase in the production capacity of stranding machine manufacturers, the customization cycle is also shortening.

The above is the explanation by the stranding machine manufacturer of the spindle adjustment methods for fully automatic high-speed stranding machines. We believe that through today's content you now understand the spindle adjustment methods of fully automatic high-speed stranding machines, and we hope it is helpful to you.

Company Profile - About Us - Qingfeng Electrical Machinery
东莞市庆丰电工机械有限公司成立于2000年.
Dongguan Qingfeng Electrical Machinery Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000.
我们是面向全球长期致力于电线、电缆、光缆等设备技术研发、制造、服务为一体的高科技企业.我们可根据客户特殊要求提供理想的解决方案,依据线缆结构,结合实际工艺要求,提供相应的专业技术方案.

We are a high-tech enterprise that, on a global scale and over the long term, has been dedicated to the R&D, manufacturing and service of wire, cable and optical fiber cable equipment. We can provide ideal solutions according to customers' special requirements, and offer corresponding professional technical solutions based on the cable structure and actual process requirements.
作为中国顶级线缆设备制造商之一,设有国内及国际两个销售团队,以及研发,生产制造, 质检中心及独立的售后服务部门,提供售前,售中,售后全系列服务. 现有庆丰电工科技（香港）有限公司、东莞市沙田盛丰电工机械厂、昆山市丰盛电工机械有限公司等四家公司。自有厂房占地面积9000平方,固定资产超过1500万, 90多位员工,技术人员12名,大型CNC车床,铣镗床加工中心.

As one of China's top cable equipment manufacturers, we operate both domestic and international sales teams, along with R&D, production and manufacturing, quality inspection centers and an independent after-sales service department, providing a full range of pre-sales, in-sales and after-sales services. There are currently four companies, including Qingfeng Electrical Technology (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd., Dongguan Shatian Shengfeng Electrical Machinery Factory and Kunshan Fengsheng Electrical Machinery Co., Ltd. With an in-house factory area of 9,000 square meters, fixed assets of over RMB 15 million, more than 90 employees, 12 technical staff, and large CNC lathes and milling-boring machining centers.
我们有超过20年的制造经验，15年以上的自有工厂制造历史，10年以上出口经验，到目前为止，我们的产品销往全球超过30个国家. 我们将一如继往向所有客户提供最优质的服务,与广大客户一起携手共进,共同成长,共创更好明天.

We have over 20 years of manufacturing experience, more than 15 years of in-house factory history, and more than 10 years of export experience. So far, our products have been sold to over 30 countries around the world. We will, as always, provide the highest quality services to all customers, and work hand in hand with them to grow together and create a better tomorrow.

Chairman's Message - About Us - Qingfeng Electrical Machinery

东莞市庆丰电工机械有限公司是面向全球长期致力于电线、电缆、光缆等设备技术研发、制造、服务为一体的高科技企业. 公司始终坚持 ” 诚信铸就品牌,品质赢得天下”的经营理念.经过十多年的发展, 已经由一家小型企业成长为中国最顶级线缆设备制造商之一. 我们秉承客户导向,热情专业,积极创新,互利共赢的原则, 始终长期专注于高品质线缆设备的研发与制造,为不同的客户提供一流的个性化需求的设备及最理想的线缆解决方案.

Dongguan Qingfeng Electrical Machinery Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise that, on a global scale and over the long term, has been dedicated to the R&D, manufacturing and service of wire, cable and optical fiber cable equipment. The company has always adhered to the business philosophy of "integrity builds the brand, quality wins the world." After more than ten years of development, it has grown from a small enterprise into one of China's top cable equipment manufacturers. Following the principles of customer orientation, warm professionalism, active innovation and mutual benefit, we have always stayed focused on the R&D and manufacturing of high-quality cable equipment, providing customers with first-class equipment tailored to their individual needs and the most ideal cable solutions.

我们坚持 “ 技术是根, 创新是魂, 人才是本” 的发展理理念, 在坚持企业管理规范化,运作市场化的同时兼顾 “ 以人为本” 的人性化管理. 我们对进入团队的每一位员工进行严格的技术考核和进行系统化的技术培训, 注重员工的学习能力,并在实在工作中不断对其进行引导和挖掘. 技术在沉淀,企业在成长,企业的团队在不断壮大, 经营管理不断科学化, 塑造企业灵魂,心系客户, 心系团队,肩负起社会的责任,为社会创造更美好的生活而一起努力.

We adhere to the development philosophy that "technology is the root, innovation is the soul, and talent is the foundation." While upholding standardized corporate management and market-oriented operations, we also practice people-oriented, humanized management. Every employee who joins our team undergoes strict technical assessment and systematic technical training. We value our employees' learning ability and continuously guide and develop them through practical work. As technology accumulates and the company grows, our team keeps expanding and management becomes increasingly scientific. We shape the corporate spirit, keep customers and the team close to heart, shoulder our social responsibilities, and work together to create a better life for society.
我们始终以 “ 质量第一,客户至上” 的经营方针, 本着 “ 以技术创新求进步, 以管理科学化求发展” 原则, 积积开拓,不断进断,我们热忱欢迎和十分感谢行业朋友的光临指导,并一如既往与广大客户朋友精诚合作,共同发展,共创辉煌.

We have always operated on the principle of "quality first, customer foremost," following the guideline of "seeking progress through technological innovation and development through scientific management." We keep forging ahead and improving. We warmly welcome and deeply appreciate the guidance of friends in the industry, and will, as always, work sincerely with our customers to grow together and create brilliance.
